seo.title: Multiples of 5 Speed Grid - 5s Times Table Math Game
seo.metaDescription: Find all multiples of 5 on a 10x10 number grid. Speed-click numbers ending in 5 or 0 before the countdown runs out.
seo.intro: Skip counting by fives is one of the earliest multiplication milestones for young students. Multiples of 5 follow an intuitive, rhythmic pattern: their ones digit alternates continuously between 5 and 0. On a standard 10-wide hundreds board, they form two distinct vertical columns in the 5th and 10th positions. This game develops rapid visual recognition of nickels, clock minutes, and tally marks.
seo.howToPlay: Click all numbers on the 100-grid that are multiples of 5 (ending in 5 or 0). Correct clicks turn green with checkmarks. Incorrect tiles flash red and penalize 2 seconds. Find all 20 multiples of 5 to win 3 stars.
seo.teacherNotes: Relate this game directly to reading an analog clock, where each hour number corresponds to five elapsed minutes (e.g. 3 on the clock represents 15 minutes).

faq.q: What is the divisibility rule for 5?
faq.a: A number is divisible by 5 if and only if its final digit is either 0 or 5.

faq.q: How many multiples of 5 exist between 1 and 100?
faq.a: There are exactly 20 multiples of 5 between 1 and 100 (10 ending in 5, and 10 ending in 0).
